• Single upload: files under 1 GB

div.div:
KEDA Autoscaling
• Workers scale from 1 to 3 based on Redis queue depth
• Queue length is the primary trigger
• API and worker scale independently
• Each worker owns one end-to-end video pipeline at a time

Matryoshka Embeddings
• 512d coarse vectors for fast pre-filtering
• 3072d full vectors for precise ranking
• Two-stage retrieval: coarse → full
• Redis cache by content hash (7-day TTL)
• Native Neo4j vector indexes

Real-time Progress
• Redis Pub/Sub → WebSocket → UI progress bar
• Progress percentage is emitted for each pipeline stage
• Temporal chains add FOLLOWED_BY edges
• Community detection clusters co-occurring entities
• Entity-topic links enable richer downstream queries
